attrs.content: Can’t find the answer you’re looking for? Contact our team.

items.title: Is it really free?
items.content: Yes. The builder and theme are open source under the GPL.

items.title: Does it work with my theme?
items.content: It works with any theme. The companion theme adds tighter integration for headers and footers.

items.title: What happens if I deactivate the plugin?
items.content: Your content is kept as clean HTML in the post, so pages stay readable.

items.title: Can AI tools build pages for me?
items.content: Yes. The built-in MCP server lets any compatible client create and edit pages, templates and menus.
